segments.text: Scroll down and Kajj carries the camera through a rain soaked night at a Kyoto mountain temple. 3JS builds the Tory gates, lanterns, fog, falling leaves,
and moon in real time, while generated scene plates and foreground artwork add depth across five chapters. The experience lives in one HTML file with
no build step or runtime network dependency.
